prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func CircularDeltas(input string) (string, bool)
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed decimal integers in -1000..1000. Return next-minus-current for each position, with the first value following the last; a singleton returns 0. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 2,5,1 returns 3,-4,1.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
